parsed.rationale: Well-appearing 3-year-old with moderate fever for only 2 days, drinking well, playful between fevers, no rash—consistent with a routine viral illness. Supportive care (fluids, antipyretics as directed) with monitoring; seek care if fever persists beyond 5 days, child becomes lethargic or hard to wake, stops drinking/urinating, develops rash, breathing difficulty, or fever exceeds 104F.
